description: [Free] Copies a scene into another of your videos with its footage and generated media, so nothing is filmed or generated again. A recording cannot change aspect, nor go into a film made from data. Does not re-render.

after_scene_id.description: Put it after this scene of the target. Omitted: at the end.

from_video_id.description: The video the scene is in.

scene_id.description: The scene to copy, from get_storyboard.

to_video_id.description: The video to copy it into (may be the same one).

name: copy_scene
title: Copy a scene into another video
